_: The Agents' wing: one office per specialist agent, in its own colours, with a door into its dashboard. Add your own here (lesson GS-09 and prompts/README.md, 'Put it in the office'). key: lower-case id. machine: the machine (workspace.config.json machines) it runs on. status: live, building or planned. door.local: its dashboard on that machine (opens only while it is running); door.phone: its tailnet address once tailscale serve publishes it (the office never proxies a dashboard). probe: how the office checks every 20 s whether it is running: {port, path} on its own machine, or {url} at its tailnet address (https://...ts.net) so it shows running from every machine and the phone (an answer below 500 counts; never a path that hands out a login token). match: words that find its sessions on the floor by title or folder; only their count is shown. brand: its colours (bg, panel, ink, accent, accent2), a font, and an optional mark (an image under public/agents/); with no mark its first letter is drawn. art: an optional full figure that stands inside the open door (an svg in public/agents/, written /agents/<file>.svg); without one its mark stands there. jokes: up to 12 lines of 160 characters or fewer it answers with when someone right-clicks its door to knock.
